category_edits.rationale: Reduce causal pooled-state contribution from 20% to 15% to emphasize immediate recurrent interest across all four datasets. Retain the three-interaction half-life, causal padding exclusion, final-real-position inference, and one GRU4Rec checkpoint per category.

change_summary: Change the shared GRU readout blend to 0.85 recurrent state plus 0.15 causal mean, and synchronize checkpoint metadata and embedded predictor validation.
